note: Harr's research queue. The village earns INSIGHT from recorded facts (places found, stages built, projects finished, people who lent a hand at a work site, events held). Technologies are learned in this order as insight accumulates. Effects are small, scripted and listed here; they change only the pantry today. Unlocking a technology never gives coins, items or power over anyone.

techs.name: Field notes
techs.text: Scholars sketch and label every find, so each page in the Library is richer.

techs.name: Soil science
techs.text: Farmers learn which soils suit which crops.

techs.name: Clean water works
techs.text: The well is lined and the spring is tapped; the pantry kitchen has water at hand.

techs.name: Solar lanterns
techs.text: Lamps charge by day and light the paths all night. Next stop: a lit, walkable village.

techs.name: Composting
techs.text: Nothing is wasted; scraps become rich soil.

techs.name: Glasswork
techs.text: Clear panes make bright, warm greenhouses and observatory domes possible.

techs.name: Vertical farming
techs.text: Crops grown in stacked light-filled rooms feed more people from less land.

techs.name: Valley mapping
techs.text: Every discovered place is drawn on a shared map that anyone can read.

techs.name: The open archive
techs.text: All findings are kept in a public archive that other villages can learn from.

techs.name: Sky transit
techs.text: Quiet light-rail and landing pads join Harr to the wider world.

techs.name: Rainwater cisterns
techs.text: Deep tiled basins capture hill runoff, keeping kitchen sinks flowing even through dry spells.

techs.name: Herbal cultivation
techs.text: Terraced chamomile and mint beds yield soothing teas that lift spirits after long building days.

techs.name: Timber joinery
techs.text: Interlocking mortise joints let carpenters frame expansive halls without relying on scarce metal bolts.

techs.name: Natural dye vats
techs.text: Marigold and madder extracts give festival banners and cottage awnings warm, cheerful hues.

techs.name: Root cellar vaults
techs.text: Subterranean stone pantries keep winter squashes and cheeses fresh for months without spoilage.

techs.name: Solar ground paving
techs.text: Walkway tiles absorb midday heat and radiate a gentle guiding luminescence through dark evenings.

techs.name: Aquaponic basins
techs.text: Closed-loop water tanks nurture fresh greens and pond fish together with zero chemical runoff.

techs.name: Acoustic amphitheatre
techs.text: Curved cedar sound reflectors carry storytellers quietest whispers to the very top terrace.

techs.name: Mushroom cultivation
techs.text: Fanned oak log racks in shaded caverns produce rich edible fungi that replenish pantry shelves.

techs.name: Quiet wind array
techs.text: Vertical-axis spiral vanes spin silently on the ridge, providing steady power during overcast days.

techs.name: Ecological surveys
techs.text: Systematic habitat notes record migratory bird flocks and pollinator pathways across every meadow.

techs.name: Continuous ceramic kilns
techs.text: Even heat distribution produces durable glazed roof tiles and food-safe pantry containers.

techs.name: Heirloom seed sanctuary
techs.text: Carefully catalogued grain and vegetable varieties safeguard regional food diversity for future decades.

techs.name: Elevated skywalk network
techs.text: Canopy-level timber boardwalks let residents stroll between quarters while preserving ground flora.

techs.name: Optical lens grinding
techs.text: Precision ground crystal lenses reveal fine cellular structures in mosses and distant lunar craters.

techs.name: Stellar spectroscopy
techs.text: Prism split light patterns reveal mineral compositions of distant stars from the observatory dome.

techs.name: Plant fibre biopolymers
techs.text: Flexible woven composites made from hemp and mycelium replace brittle metal fasteners across construction.

techs.name: Geothermal heating loops
techs.text: Circulating groundwater warms greenhouse soil in winter and cools dwelling floors through midsummer.

techs.name: The universal lexicon
techs.text: A unified open encyclopaedia harmonizes botanical, architectural, and astronomical terms for all researchers.

techs.name: Harmonic village commons
techs.text: With clean energy, shared abundance, and living scholarship fully realized, Harr thrives in lasting harmony.
